name: Chart Block – turn your data into clear visual stories
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Turn raw numbers into beautiful, responsive charts your readers instantly understand – right inside the Gutenberg editor, no spreadsheet screenshots required.

Live Demo | Support

Why Chart Block?

Tables full of numbers make visitors skim. Chart Block turns tabular numeric data into clear visual stories – bar, pie, line, scatter, radar, gauge, heatmap, candlestick, funnel, stacked, and grouped bar charts – all rendered responsively on every device.

Enter data manually in the editor, or import large datasets from CSV or JSON files in seconds. Every chart is fully customizable: dimensions, pointer styles, grid lines, legends, typography, and even currency symbols for financial reporting. Visitors can export charts as high-resolution PNG images or download the underlying data as CSV/JSON.

You can easily switch a chart from one type to another, and a shortcode generator lets you place charts anywhere on your site – not just in block-based content.

Free Features

  • 9+ Chart Types: Bar, Pie, Line, Scatter, Radar, Gauge, Heatmap, Candlestick, Funnel, Stacked, and Grouped Bar charts.
  • Custom Dimensions: Set the chart width and height for perfect layout integration.
  • Pointer Styles: Choose from 10+ pointer styles (Circle, Cross, Star, Triangle, and more) with custom size and hover radius.
  • Grid Controls: Set custom grid line colors and label colors to match your site’s theme.
  • CSV & JSON Import: Effortlessly import large datasets directly from CSV or JSON files.
  • Export Capability: Export charts as high-resolution PNG images or download data in CSV/JSON formats.
  • Manual Data Entry: Enter and edit data directly in the Gutenberg editor.
  • Advanced Typography: Full control over Google Fonts, font weights, and responsive font sizes for titles, labels, and legends.
  • Custom Currency Support: Add any currency symbol ($, €, £, etc.) and format data for global financial reporting.
  • Specialized Scales: Custom color scales and diverging palettes for heatmaps and multi-series charts.
  • Legend Options: Control legend position (Top, Left, Bottom, Right) and customize label colors.
  • Shortcode Support: Use charts anywhere on your site with the easy shortcode generator.
  • Responsive Design: All charts work perfectly on all devices.
  • Priority Support: Direct access to our technical support team for fast troubleshooting and feature requests.

Pro Version

  • Advanced Controls: Segments Separate, Donut & Semi-circle mode.
  • Professional Styling: Toggle Legend, Grid & Axis for all charts.
  • Enhanced Visuals: Customize Point Styles, Fill Area, and Curve Types.
  • Download Button: Toggle show/hide for charts in the front-end UI.
  • Animation Controls: Full control over chart animations and speed.
  • Advanced Typography: Custom Google Fonts and multi-device sizing.
  • Customization: Currency Symbols and Advanced Data Editor.

How to Use – Quick Start

  1. Install and activate the Chart Block plugin.
  2. In the Gutenberg editor, add the Chart Block from the “Widgets” block category.
  3. Enter your data manually or import it from a CSV/JSON file.
  4. Adjust the chart type, colors, legend, and typography from the right-side settings sidebar.
  5. Publish – your chart is live and fully responsive.

Use Cases

  • Business Reports: Present revenue, growth, and KPI data with bar and line charts.
  • Finance Sites: Display market data with candlestick and gauge charts, complete with currency symbols.
  • Marketing & Sales Pages: Visualize funnels and comparisons that support your pitch.
  • Education & Research: Turn datasets into readable heatmaps, radar, and scatter charts.
  • Bloggers & Journalists: Back up stories with clean, exportable data visuals.

Did you like this plugin? Have a feature request? Please share your feedback with us.

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external services from the admin dashboard:

bPlugins API

  • Service URL: https://api.bplugins.com
  • Purpose: The plugin’s admin dashboard fetches product comparison data and pricing information to display relevant upgrade options and feature details.
  • Data Sent: Only the plugin slug is transmitted; no personal or site data is collected.
  • Terms of Service: https://bplugins.com/terms-of-service/
  • Privacy Policy: https://bplugins.com/privacy-policy/

WordPress.org Plugins API

  • Service URL: https://api.wordpress.org/plugins/info/1.2/
  • Purpose: The admin dashboard queries the official WordPress.org Plugins API to retrieve and display a curated list of other plugins by the same author (“Our Plugins” section).
  • Data Sent: Plugin slugs and author name; no personal or site data is collected.
  • Terms of Service: https://wordpress.org/about/tos/
  • Privacy Policy: https://wordpress.org/about/privacy/

Third-Party Libraries / bpl tools

  • Source / GitHub: https://github.com/bPlugins/bpl-tools
  • License: GPL-2.0-or-later – https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html
  • Purpose: Shared utility library providing admin dashboard components and common Gutenberg editor controls.
  • External Services: The library may connect to bPlugins, WordPress.org, and Freemius services for product data and checkout functionality. See full details: https://github.com/bPlugins/bpl-tools#external-requests–why-they-are-made
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard (recommended):

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “Chart Block”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. In the Gutenberg editor, search for the Chart Block and add it to any post or page.

Manual installation:

  1. Download the Chart Block plugin (.zip file).
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New and click Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the chart-block.zip file, click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Alternatively, upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory and activate it from the Plugins menu.
sections.faq:
Is Chart Block free?

Yes, Chart Block is a free Gutenberg block plugin. A Pro version with additional styling, animation, and data controls is also available.

What chart types can I create?

You can create Bar, Pie, Line, Scatter, Radar, Gauge, Heatmap, Candlestick, Funnel, Stacked, and Grouped Bar charts – and easily switch a chart from one type to another.

Can I import data from CSV or JSON files?

Yes. You can import large datasets directly from CSV or JSON files, or enter and edit data manually in the Gutenberg editor.

Can visitors download or export a chart?

Yes. Charts can be exported as high-resolution PNG images, and the underlying data can be downloaded in CSV or JSON format.

Can I use charts outside the block editor?

Yes. The built-in shortcode generator lets you place charts anywhere on your site.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it will work with any standard WordPress theme.

Can I change block settings?

Yes, you can change block settings from the Gutenberg block editor’s right sidebar.

How many times can I reuse the block?

You can use the block unlimited times across your site.

Where can I get support?

You can post your questions on the support forum here.
